headline: The timeline they don't put in the press release

items.title: Emergency preamble signed
items.detail: Takes effect immediately; a referendum petition can no longer stay it. Reasons given: "without delay" (AP), "Day One implementation" (NBC Boston).

items.title: The law's own original effective date
items.detail: Where the normal 90-day clock would have ended.

items.title: 93,229 signatures submitted
items.detail: Raw count filed by the repeal campaign.

items.title: 78,707 signatures verified
items.detail: Certifies the question for the November 3, 2026 ballot.

note: Under Article 48, a certified petition normally stays a law until voters decide. An emergency preamble removes that stay.
sources: Sources: Ballotpedia · Foley Hoag LLP · AP / NBC Boston (Oct 2, 2024)
